item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas lcags phag lo'i zla tshes sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs/ ge ta brag ces nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs pa'o/ slar yang zla tshes la sa skyongs bsod nams can gyi pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse nas/ shog ser bod yig tu phab grub pa bgyis so//
